answer: Who trusts a mask vouched for only by its own kin? Weight must come solely from attesters scattered across a tundra of the trust graph, no two within three steps of each other, each attestation sealed by one walnut bond. A farm's masks huddle close together, so their mutual vouches collapse into a single voice; ten close masks pay ten walnuts yet earn one share, while the nectar flows only to masks vouched from afar. I play one mask, pay one bond, and take only what distant vouches earn.
